meta.axes: X east, Y up, Z south (Z = -(northing - origin.northing)); metres
notes: Grid 10 m spacing over the circuit extent plus 300 m (189 x 267); 2373 grid points on or within 3 m of the ribbon removed.
Triangulated together with the lap ribbon's outer shoulder edges as constraints (cdt2d), keeping faces outside the ribbon, so road -> shoulder -> ground is one continuous surface.
Heights: nearest 0.5 m DTM cell per grid point (bare earth: no trees or buildings); ribbon edge vertices keep their baked heights.

Fold patch: at the La Source hairpin the narrowed inner shoulder folds over itself; that edge-loop crossing is cut before triangulating, and a 1 m grid patch (364 triangles) lies under the fold at heights interpolated (inverse distance) from nearby ribbon edge vertices, 0.05 m below them, so no hole remains.

Constrained Delaunay terrain: 102253 triangles sharing the ribbon's outer edge vertices (6982 after cutting 1 shoulder folds at La Source); 1 kept faces partly under the ribbon (at the hairpin fold; all fully covered faces removed).
